scope: Static download and inspection of public updater and self-test helper scripts; no execution or Host/API/SSH/credential use.

static_findings.claim: The public updater retrieves start_self_test.sh by name.
For an unlisted machine, the public helper invokes a temporary listing before self-test and then attempts unlisting.
static_findings.boundary: Static control flow only; no runtime completion, cleanup, or marketplace observation.

static_findings.claim: The existing-listed early exit is safe to rely on for a new-host action.
static_findings.boundary: It proves only an early exit on a literal listed field, not target ownership, pricing, expiry, self-test success, or authorization.

static_findings.claim: Stock installer/TUI can publish with the exact authorized price, minimum-bid, storage-price, end-date, and no-reboot constraints.
blockers: No source-exposed controls for all required values.
Helper omits -b and -s and fixes end time as now plus 10800 seconds.
On-host vast executable identity and flag semantics are not proven.
No safe fresh target/lifecycle/runtime evidence exists.

static_findings.claim: The stock path cannot reboot the host.
static_findings.boundary: The inspected installer has no direct reboot invocation and its default driver-install condition is favorable, but it invokes an external driver installer and does not prove no reboot on a future artifact or host.

local_reference_only.purpose: Explains the local source meaning of list-machine flags only.
local_reference_only.provenance_limit: Not proven identical to /var/lib/vastai_kaalia/vast used by the public helper.

authorization: No installation, registration, listing, self-test, workload, reboot, or readiness claim is authorized by this source inspection.
